limits: Auth HTTP/gateway/provider durations are nested/overlapping and include different transport/scheduling/body boundaries. Signed differences are descriptive gaps, not pure network or SDK CPU.
Provider logs have no response UUID join in this fixture; complete duration aggregates are separate, not invented per-request matches.
GC overlap is temporal, not exclusive pause attribution; per-second event-loop windows and role/container samples can miss brief events.
One controlled app process supplies monotonic clocks; process-wide CPU/resource counters overlap concurrent requests.
All observations are instrumented local diagnosis and cannot establish hosted causes or production capacity.
